program.source: "use strict";function compute(a,b){let n=a;let count=0;while(n>0&&n%2===0){count=count+1;n=n/2;}return count+b;}async function run(key,pair){const observed=await host.readAsync(key);const a=pair.a;const b=pair.b;let answer=compute(a,b)+observed;await host.withCallback(key,function(delta){answer=answer+delta;host.store(key,answer);});return answer;}
